name: Good Day cashew cookie
ingredients: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR, SUGAR, EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALM), SUGAR, CASHEW BUTS (4.5%), INTERESTERIFIED VEGETABLE FAT, COCOA SOLIDS (3%), INVERT SYRUP, MILK SOLIDS, BUTTER (0.6%) RAISING AGENTS [503(II), 500(II), IODISED SALT AND EMULSIFIER(322, 471, 472E). CONTAINS ADDED FLAVOURS [NATURE IDENTICAL AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES - MILK AND VANILLA]
